items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: So the Jeter-Pillars was the one --, Jeter was an alto saxophone player and Pillars was a tenor player. They decided they would get the band going, you know.

ctx.x: Stuff Smith was in that band, yeah. Snuff Smith was in that band. Alphonso Trent, he got sick up in Bangor, Maine, up there, they were doing one-nighters. So he went back to Ft. Smith, Arkansas. So the band came through Columbus, Ohio and broke up. So the Jeter-Pillars was the one --, Jeter was an alto saxophone player and Pillars was a tenor player. They decided they would get the band going, you know.
They were both in Trent's band, I see.
